title: Hobbies Make Our Life Interesting
兴趣爱好让我们的生活更有趣

sentences: Alice made lots of new friends in the new school.
爱丽丝在新学校交了很多新朋友。
She invited her friends Lily, Dan and Richard to her home on Sunday.
周日她邀请朋友莉莉、丹和理查德来家里。
Alice's friends came to her room.
爱丽丝的朋友们来到了她的房间。
There were several toys and dolls on the shelf.
架子上放着几个玩具和玩偶。
A stamp album on the desk was noticed by Lily.
莉莉注意到了桌子上的一本集邮册。
Lily pointed it and asked Alice, "You like collecting stamps, right?"
莉莉指着它问爱丽丝：「你喜欢集邮，对吗？」
"Yes.
「是的。
I also like painting and photographing to record the beauty of the daily life," answered Alice and then she asked, "What are your hobbies, guys?"
我也喜欢绘画和拍照来记录日常生活的美好，」爱丽丝回答，然后她问：「你们的爱好是什么，伙计们？」
"Actually I like listening to classical music played by the violin and piano and going to the opera.
「实际上我喜欢听小提琴和钢琴演奏的古典音乐，也喜欢去看歌剧。
But last week my father took me to a rock concert.
但上周我父亲带我去了摇滚音乐会。
A rock band made me interested.
一支摇滚乐队让我产生了兴趣。
When the singer sang songs, the other members in the band played the musical instruments like the guitar, drums.
当歌手唱歌时，乐队其他成员弹奏吉他、鼓等乐器。
So now I also enjoy listening to rock music.
所以现在我也喜欢听摇滚乐。
In the future, I hope to be a musician," answered Richard quickly.
将来，我希望成为一名音乐家，」理查德快速回答。
Lily is a girl who is very active.
莉莉是一个非常活跃的女孩。
She answered, "Wow, you like art, but I am interested in taking adventures.
她回答说：「哇，你喜欢艺术，但我对冒险感兴趣。
I love going camping with my parents.
我喜欢和父母去露营。
It is so wonderful to be surrounded by nature."
被大自然包围真是太棒了。」
Dan is a quiet boy.
丹是一个安静的男孩。
He said, "Sounds fun!
他说：「听起来很有趣！
But I prefer to read newspapers, magazines, comics and draw pictures."
但我更喜欢读报纸、杂志、漫画和画画。」
"I watch cartoon films sometimes.
「我有时看卡通电影。
We should play together more often.
我们应该更经常一起玩。
What about playing cards or board games like chess next weekend?" said Richard.
下周末打牌或下棋之类的桌游怎么样？」理查德说。
"Great!
「太好了！
I will get bored without you guys.
没有你们这些伙计我会无聊的。
It is so lucky to have you to be my friends." Alice spoke out her feelings excitedly.
很幸运有你们成为我的朋友。」爱丽丝激动地说出了她的感受。

words: A friend painted the children for me
一位朋友给我画了孩子们的画像。
Will you sing us a song?
